_comment: Declared debt for scripts/check-locale-render.mjs: cells that render blank
in an offered locale where English renders text, so the reader of that
language is looking at an empty control.
Each key maps to the explicit SET of locales still blank, never a count. A
count cannot tell a repaired cell from a newly broken one, and a bare key
list goes green the moment the first locale is filled in. Same shape, and
This list may only shrink. A cell blank and not named here fails the
guard. A cell named here and no longer blank is reported on every run with
the line to delete, and does not fail, because several sessions edit these
files at once and a guard that turns red when somebody repairs a string is
a guard that gets switched off. Trim it in the change that repaired the
Recorded 2026-08-26 from the committed tree, 25 cells across 9 keys.

clash.save_profile_hint.reason: Written as an empty string in all three files. The English source is a sentence explaining what a saved clash profile keeps, so the hint is simply absent for those readers.

clash.profiles.subtitle.reason: Empty string. The clash profiles page carries no subtitle at all in these three languages.

clash.profiles.deleteMessage.reason: Empty string. This is the confirmation text of a delete dialog, so the dialog asks for confirmation without saying what is being deleted.

clash.profiles.noProjectHint.reason: Empty string. The prompt telling the reader to pick a project is missing, leaving an empty state with no instruction.

clash.profiles.emptyHint.reason: Empty string. The empty state of the profiles list explains nothing in these languages.

clash.profiles.selectHint.reason: Empty string. The prompt to pick a profile from the list is missing.

clash.profiles.editHint.reason: Empty string. The note about where selection sets and per discipline rules are edited is missing.

clash.profiles.noModels.reason: Empty string. The message telling the reader to upload a BIM model first is missing, so the blocked state gives no reason.

login.hero_h_a.reason: Empty string. This is the first fragment of the login page headline, which the page assembles from several keys, so the Kyrgyz headline starts mid sentence.
